comparison.objective: Align and press a tube into two self-closing clamps until both double-click and lock; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part alignment and forceful dual snap insertion versus hex-key engagement, collar tuning, counterholding and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Both clamps seated and mechanically locked with the tube released versus tuned impact response and setting retention over repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: This is snap-fit assembly, not iterative commissioning, despite shared alignment and latching primitives. Candidate has no numeric rebound, overload or drift tolerance.
